title.description: Short dev-facing title, used as the commit subject, e.g. 'Services: softer script style for Planning heading'

owner_summary.description: One plain-English sentence the owner will read and approve. No jargon.

route.description: Site route the change is on, e.g. /services, or * for site-wide

edit_id.description: data-edit-id or content JSON path if known, else empty

file_hint.description: Most likely file to change, from the site map

attachments.description: Attachment file names this item uses

source_quote.description: The owner's own words this item comes from

item.description: 1-based item number the question is about, or null for a request not yet turned into an item

ask.description: Short, friendly question in plain English

options.description: 2-4 likely answers, or empty for free text
